named.name: Gatebreaker's Horn
named.text: Hacked from the Siege Beast's skull. It still hums when the Rift Gate opens.

named.name: The Crown
named.text: The old King's crown, taken from the drowned palace. Whoever wears it hears his bargain, still being made.

named.name: The Mother's Cord
named.text: A loop of something that was alive in the Nest. It tightens when the wearer starts to drift.

named.name: The Goblin Lord's Cleaver
named.text: Notched, filthy, and much sharper than it looks. The Goblin Lord never cleaned it.

named.name: Heartwood Staff
named.text: Cut from the Tree King's heart. Small green shoots come out of it in spring.

named.name: The Bride's Veil
named.text: Black lace from the Vampire Queen's court. It smells of cold churches.

named.name: Scylla's Fang
named.text: One tooth from the Marches' hunger, long as a forearm and still wet.

named.name: Colossus Plate
named.text: A slab of the Stone Colossus, hammered into armor. It weighs less than it should.

named.name: The Dark General's Standard
named.text: A demon legion's banner, cut down and nailed to a shield. Its soldiers still salute it.

named.name: Orochi Scale
named.text: One scale from an eight-headed god. Fire and flood both slide off it.

named.name: The Village God's Eye
named.text: It looks out of the amulet, and it looks at you. The faceless people worshipped it for this.

named.name: The Overlord's Brand
named.text: The Pit's ruler fought with it for an age. It wants to go back.

named.name: Barrow-Warden's Lantern
named.text: A dead warden's lamp. The Barrows' dead mistake whoever carries it for one of their own.

named.name: Oathkeeper
named.text: Every knight who carried it swore something on it. It remembers each oath.

named.name: The Old Hunter's Longbow
named.text: The Beast Lands' last hunter left it at a crossroads with a note: 'Finish it.'

named.name: Wolfskin Jerkin
named.text: Still smells of the pack. Animals give way to whoever wears it.

named.name: Thornbriar Knife
named.text: A knife of black thorn from the Hollow Wood. It never quite stops growing.

named.name: The Drowned Bell
named.text: It rings under water. Hear it once and you never sleep through danger again.

named.name: Frostbitten Greaves
named.text: Rime grows on them even in summer. The Deep Cold left a little of itself inside.

named.name: The Last Smith's Hammer
named.text: The Forge Ruins' final smith built the constructs, then this to undo them.

named.name: A Mask with No Face
named.text: Smooth porcelain. Put it on, and the faceless people stop seeing you as a stranger.

named.name: The Heretic's Censer
named.text: The Apostate Court burned other gods' names in it. The smoke still curses.

named.name: Pilgrim's Staff
named.text: Worn smooth by a thousand walks to the six shrines.

named.name: Dragonbone Crossbow
named.text: Its string is a dragon's tendon. It throws bolts like a breath of flame.

named.name: Voidglass Ring
named.text: A ring of black glass from the Outer Dark. Look into it too long and it looks back.

named.name: The Twin Fangs
named.text: Two knives, always found together, never apart for long.

named.name: The Fool's Bell
named.text: A jester's bell that rings only when its bearer is about to fall, and never too late.

named.name: The Golden Wand
named.text: The Archmage's own, still warm, and still asking what it will be used for.

named.name: The Reaper's Sickle
named.text: It cuts what is ready to be cut, and seems to know which.

named.name: The Tower Stone
named.text: A cornerstone from the Colossus, which still remembers being a wall.

named.name: The Moonsilver Mirror
named.text: In it, the false light shows its true face.

named.name: The Sunbrand
named.text: A blade that holds a little noon in it, and does not like the dark.

named.name: The Thunderer's Bolt
named.text: A spear of frozen lightning, taken from a god who did not think it could be taken.

named.name: The Seventh Key
named.text: The key to the lowest gate. It is warm, and it should not be.

named.name: The Feather of Truth
named.text: Lighter than any heart. Whoever carries it finds lies weigh on them.

named.name: The Priestess's Veil
named.text: Whoever wears it hears what is not said.

named.name: The Thorn Crown
named.text: It grows a little every night, and it does not hurt the one it chose.

named.name: The Iron Sceptre
named.text: Its weight is the weight of every law ever made with it.

named.name: The Calamity Bell
named.text: It tolls the end of something every time it is rung.

named.name: The Twin Rings
named.text: Two rings fused into one. Neither will let the other go.

named.name: The Iron Wheel
named.text: A wheel of the Chariot, beaten into a shield. It still wants to roll forward.

named.name: The Lion's Hide
named.text: The pelt of a lion no blade could cut. Still none can.

named.name: The Hermit's Lantern
named.text: Its light shows only what is true, and only a little way ahead.

named.name: The Clockwork Shell
named.text: A piece of the snail's shell. It ticks, and sometimes it ticks backward.

named.name: The Feather Blade
named.text: Light as a feather, and every blow struck against its bearer is weighed and returned.

named.name: The Gallows Cord
named.text: Worn round the neck, as it was meant to be. It has never once tightened.

named.name: The Mixing Cups
named.text: Two cups on a chain. What is poured between them comes out cool.

named.name: The Devil's Fork
named.text: It takes a little more with every kill, and it never says what for.

named.name: The Fallen Star
named.text: A staff with a star caught in its head. It hums when anyone wishes nearby.

named.name: The Last Trumpet
named.text: The dead hear it and lie still, out of respect, or fear.

named.name: The World's Mantle
named.text: Woven of moss and stone and root. The ground holds up whoever wears it.
